measurement.label: Measurement · GEO optimization
measurement.title: AI search understands it too (GEO / Agent-Ready)
measurement.imageAlt: Is It Agent Ready audit of Blue Horizon scoring 63/100, Level 4 Agent-Integrated
measurement.intro: Here I cared about more than visuals and human load speed: how ChatGPT, Perplexity or Claude read the site. It scored 63/100 (Level 4: Agent-Integrated) in the Is It Agent Ready audit.
measurement.whyText: Because a site should serve the business, not fill checkboxes. Blue Horizon informs and sells tours; it doesn't need MCP servers, bot OAuth or machine-to-machine commerce. Adding them would bill you for pointless complexity.
measurement.outro: When someone asks an AI about tours in Panama, the model finds, reads and cites Blue Horizon — no invented facts.
